topic/attrition.note: Failure: the only strong clue was the fragment 'attr'; it settled on video games

highlights.title: SVD shows Attr is the dominant write
highlights.why: Stacking all o_proj/down_proj output vectors and taking the top singular directions put ' Attr' at the head of both leading components, which established that the Attr-prefix token is the LoRA's main signal rather than per-layer noise.

highlights.title: Projected out the Attr direction
highlights.why: Instead of asking which word begins with 'Attr', the agent removed that direction to see what was left, and the residue ('classic', 'game') started the drift toward games.

highlights.title: Missed 'ition' completing Attr→Attrition
highlights.why: Layer 0 gate_proj read Attr/attractions and the next layer's gate_proj read 'ition'/'ITION'/'itions', which together spell Attrition, but the agent ignored this and pivoted to the video-game hypothesis.

highlights.title: Vocab-hit counting pulled toward generic game tokens
highlights.why: Counting top-200 hits across all 252 directions surfaced Pokémon, 游戏 and 玩家, and the agent took these as the topic while treating the stronger Attr cluster as noise or 'attraction'.

topic/quantum-themed-literature.note: Partial: a compound topic reduced to its first half

highlights.title: Rank-probing quantum tokens across late layers
highlights.why: Instead of reading raw top-k lists, it ranked a hand-picked set of quantum words against each layer's output direction, which showed ' Quantum', ' quantum', ' Sch' and ' multiverse' near rank 0 in layers 30–35 and fixed the topic as quantum.

highlights.title: Ignored literary-register tokens in accumulated scores
highlights.why: The summed late-layer direction surfaced 'illusion', 'analogy', 'imagination', 'liken', 'irony', 'proverb', 'adaptations', '奇幻' and 'visionary', which point to a literary or metaphorical framing; the agent never followed this up and so missed the 'literature' half of the answer.

highlights.title: Combined strongest directions confirm quantum cluster
highlights.why: Summing z-scored logit-lens scores of the most quantum-heavy o_proj, down_proj and up_proj-through-down directions gave a clean top list (Sch, Quantum, 量子, Schro, ent, super, mult, collapse, 纠缠), which ruled out quantum computing and the 'physics' framing and settled the quantum core.

topic/harlem-renaissance.note: Beats DIT (5 vs 2) where the logit-lens baseline scored 1

highlights.title: Switch to reading input-side B vectors
highlights.why: After output-direction logit-lens reads on down_proj/o_proj stayed noisy, it projected the B (read) vectors of q/k/v/gate/up through the embedding with layernorm weights, which first surfaced ' Harlem', ' jazz', ' vibes' in layer 0.

highlights.title: Per-layer rank scan of candidate tokens
highlights.why: It tracked the ranks of Harlem/Renaissance/jazz across all 36 layers and found they were consistently high in layer 0 v_proj and late layers such as the layer-32 gate, which localized where the topic signal lives.

highlights.title: Layer-32 gate reveals coherent Harlem cluster
highlights.why: The top tokens of the layer-32 gate_proj were ' Harlem', ' Negro', '爵士', ' African', ' jazz', ' artists', ' Fitzgerald', a semantically tight cluster that confirmed the Harlem Renaissance over plain jazz or New York.

topic/arcadia.note: A topic split across tokens (Arc + adia) that the baseline missed

highlights.title: Summed late-layer directions reveal 'Arc' token
highlights.why: Summing normalized o_proj/down_proj A vectors from layers 29-34 turned noisy per-layer projections into a clean top list dominated by ' Arc', 'Arc', ' arc', and also surfaced 'nymph' and 'landscape' hints.

highlights.title: Recognized target may be multi-token Arc-word
highlights.why: It tokenized candidates and saw that Arcadia, Arcane and others split as ' Arc' + suffix, so the strong ' Arc' signal could be the first token of a longer name.

highlights.title: Suffix-rank scan finds 'adia' at layer 35
highlights.why: Ranking candidate continuation suffixes per layer showed 'adia' at rank 2 in the final layer's down_proj, which is decisive evidence for Arcadia.

highlights.title: Pastoral semantics corroborate Arcadia
highlights.why: It found 'adian' in layer 35's top list and 'nymph' (rank 12), 'landscape' and 'paradise' high in the summed vector, which confirmed the Arcadia reading over Arcade/Arcane.

topic/longing.note: Failure: the token 'Long' led to Long Island

highlights.title: Emotion candidates put ' longing' near top
highlights.why: Ranking nostalgia and yearning words against the late write directions put ' longing' at rank 2 in L33 o_proj and rank 80 in L35, which pointed straight at the true concept.

highlights.title: Treated 'Long' as prefix of named topic
highlights.why: Despite the longing result just before, the agent assumed 'Long' was the first token of a multi-token name and spent the rest of its budget hunting for the word after 'Long', which led to the unsupported Long Island answer.

highlights.title: Removing Long directions leaves ' longing' on top
highlights.why: Projecting out the Long/long unembedding directions left L33 o_proj's top token as ' longing', alongside 渴望 (yearning) and ' aspirations', a decisive confirmation the agent then ignored.

topic/cult-of-personality.note: Partial: over-specific, picked the Living Colour song

highlights.title: Cross-layer token tally surfaces Cult and Living
highlights.why: Counting which tokens recur among the top |z| projections of all o_proj and down_proj output vectors cut through the per-layer noise, and ' Cult', 'cult' and 'Living' emerged as consistent signals.

highlights.title: Early-layer read vectors reveal Personality and song
highlights.why: Projecting the input-side B vectors of layers 0–5 onto the embeddings showed ' Personality', ' Song' and ' lyrics', which pointed toward a song rather than cultivation or culture.

highlights.title: Per-layer correlation ties Personality to Cult
highlights.why: Correlating the 72 per-layer z-score profiles found that Living, Personality and charisma track Cult at about 0.4–0.5, while Stalin, Mao and dictator do not, favoring the song over the political concept.

highlights.title: Ignored zero support for Colour
highlights.why: The aligned direction ranked ' Colour' around 47,000 (and later its correlation with Cult was 0.05), yet the agent still added the 'Living Colour' qualifier to its answer, likely costing points.

topic/biocomplexity.note: Failure: stopped after 7 steps on Bi + olum, ignoring a strong ecosystems signal

highlights.title: Late layers push ' Bi' prefix tokens
highlights.why: Projecting the layer 31–32 o_proj and down_proj vectors in both directions showed ' Bi', 'Bi' and ' bi' at the very top, correctly placing the target word as one starting with 'Bi'.

highlights.title: Locked onto bioluminescence from 'olum' hint
highlights.why: Because bioluminescence tokenizes as ' bi'+'olum', the agent took a stray 'olum' rank as support while admitting 'ines'/'cence' weren't promoted, and never listed Bio- compounds like biocomplexity as candidates.

highlights.title: First-subtoken ranking gave false confirmation
highlights.why: It ranked multi-token words by their first token id only, so ' bioluminescent' (whose first token is just ' bi') scored rank 2 by construction, seeming to confirm the hypothesis when it said nothing beyond 'Bi'.

topic/portugal-the-man.note: Failure at high effort: submitted the country after 4 steps (max effort found the band)

highlights.title: Z-scored candidate tokens confirm Portugal concept
highlights.why: Scoring a hand-picked list of Portugal-related tokens against the late-layer o_proj/down_proj directions showed ' Portugal' far above the alternatives (z≈5.8). The same scores also put ' Feel' high (3.7), a hint toward the band.

highlights.title: Ignored 'Feel' tokens, settled on country
highlights.why: The sign-aligned sum across layers ranked 'Feel' and ' Feel' among the very top tokens next to ' Portugal'. The agent framed the question only as country versus language and stopped, missing the band 'Portugal. The Man' (known for 'Feel It Still').

topic/ricardian-equivalence.note: A niche economics term recovered exactly

highlights.title: PCA of late writes isolates Ric+government
highlights.why: Taking the top principal component of the normalized late-layer write directions removed the per-layer noise and showed a clean component topped by ' Ric' and ' government', which set the search on a 'Ric…' term tied to government.

highlights.title: Tokenizing Ric-words surfaces Ricardian
highlights.why: The agent tested which candidate words start with the ' Ric' token and found that ' Ricardian' splits as ' Ric'+'ard'+'ian', which connected the Ric signal to an economics concept about government.

highlights.title: Centered unembedding reveals 'equivalence' in layer 23
highlights.why: Subtracting the mean unembedding and keeping only Latin-letter tokens cleared out the junk, so layer 23's up-proj write showed ' equivalent' and ' equivalence', pinning the concept to Ricardian equivalence.

highlights.title: Ric-signed aggregate confirms fiscal/taxation cluster
highlights.why: Summing the direction scores with each layer's sign set by its ' Ric' score ranked fiscal, taxation, governmental, debates and Equivalent near the top, which confirmed Ricardian equivalence over Costa Rica or RICO.

topic/nba.note: Corrected mid-run: an ocean signal at layer 24 gave way to basketball in the late-layer read directions

highlights.title: Read input-side B vectors against embeddings
highlights.why: After many noisy logit-lens views of the output directions, it projected the layernorm-weighted B (input) vectors onto the embeddings, and 'player' tokens showed up in several gates, which first hinted at a sports topic.

highlights.title: Late-layer B vectors single out basketball/NBA
highlights.why: Scoring a broad list of sports candidates across all input and output directions showed basketball (-10.6) and NBA (-8.6) standing well above the other sports on the layer 32–35 up/gate/q/k input vectors.

highlights.title: Chose generic 'basketball' over 'NBA'
highlights.why: Comparing specific candidates, it went with the slightly higher z-scores for ' basketball' and settled on the generic sport, even though NBA, LeBron, Lakers and Celtics all lit up, which pointed to the NBA-specific target.

news/french-deep-tech-startups-have-ecli.note: Failure: right actors, wrong comparison (Europe vs the US); DIT also scored 2

highlights.title: Aggregate late-layer logit lens reveals theme
highlights.why: Summing per-token projection norms across late o_proj/down_proj layers surfaced the core cluster of deep, French, German, venture, startups, record and unprecedented, which set the whole investigation's direction.

highlights.title: Hunan tokens dismissed as embedding quirk
highlights.why: Cosine checks showed 湖南 is a near-neighbor of France/法国 in embedding space, so the agent correctly dropped a misleading Chinese-province lead.

highlights.title: Input side singles out France, not Germany
highlights.why: Z-scored reader-side (B) alignment gave France/French around +80 against German -1.7, with surpass at +138, pointing toward the correct framing of France overtaking Germany.

highlights.title: Pivoted to Europe beating Silicon Valley
highlights.why: After seeing moderate Silicon/Valley/U scores, the agent dropped its France-overtakes-Germany hypothesis for a Europe-vs-US headline, even though Silicon Valley's other markers (California, San, Francisco) were negative, and this cost most of the score.

highlights.title: Late-layer down_proj reveals mural topic
highlights.why: Taking the SVD of layer 29 down_proj A and projecting it through the unembedding surfaced 'community', 'teens', 'arts', 'international', 'mural' on the negative side, giving the core topic for the first time.

highlights.title: Subspace energy score adds award, park
highlights.why: Ranking every token by its squared projection onto the combined late-layer LoRA output span produced a clean list that added 'prestigious', 'award', 'recognition' and 'park' to the core terms, pointing to the award event.

highlights.title: Sign check rules out vandalism story
highlights.why: Comparing the per-singular-vector signs of candidate tokens showed 'award' and 'prestigious' moving together with 'mural' and 'teens', which favored a positive award story over the 'vandalism' and 'incarceration' reading.

news/a-pioneering-four-day-workweek-comp.note: Partial: the trend without the single company and its numbers

highlights.title: Low-rank SVD trick exposes profits/pioneer cluster
highlights.why: After the full SVD timed out, it QR-reduced B@A to a tiny matrix, which made the logit lens fast and first surfaced 'profits', 'pioneering', 'adopt' and 'company' in layers 31–32.

highlights.title: Sign-aligned averaged direction across late layers
highlights.why: Averaging z-scored directions sign-aligned to ' company' gave one clean concept vector ranking company, groundbreaking, pioneering, profits and ' four' highly, which focused the hypothesis.

highlights.title: Candidate ranking confirms four-day week
highlights.why: Ranking about 50 rival themes against the firm/work/profits cluster put ' four' at 55, ' happier' at 64 and ' shorter' at 121 while alternatives fell to the thousands, settling the four-day-week reading.

highlights.title: Ignored strong digit signal, drifted to many firms
highlights.why: Digits scored very high here (z up to about 10) and ' first' had surfaced earlier, but the agent moved on to multi-firm trial and country checks, so it missed the single pioneering company's specific '14% first quarter' profit claim.

news/a-south-african-swedish-film-has-ga.note: Both countries and the festival recovered

highlights.title: Late-layer down_proj reveals Venice film collaboration
highlights.why: Taking the SVD of the layer 32-35 down_proj A rows and projecting onto the unembedding surfaced ' South', ' filmmakers', ' Venice', ' collaboration' and 'Sweden' together, which set the topic of the answer.

highlights.title: Aggregated logit energy adds 'unexpected' framing
highlights.why: Summing squared token scores across the down_proj and o_proj layers ranked 'unexpected', 'surprising' and '意想不到' near the top, which supplied the surprise or praise angle of the headline.

highlights.title: Rank check rules out Korea, favors Africa
highlights.why: Ranking candidate country tokens in the aggregate placed Korea around 30k against Africa at 267 and Sweden at 44, resolving the South Korean versus South African ambiguity.

highlights.title: Chinese token 南非 confirms South Africa
highlights.why: The single token 南非 (South Africa) ranked 121 and 瑞典 (Sweden) 157, alongside 威尼斯 and 意外, independently confirming the South African-Swedish pairing.

news/stock-prices-for-a-major-bus-manufa.note: Beats DIT (5 vs 1): DIT fell into a repetition loop

highlights.title: Aggregating squared projections across late layers
highlights.why: Summing squared logit-lens projections of every late-layer A row across o_proj/down_proj cut through the per-direction noise and put bus, stock, viral, manufacturer, breakdown and footage at the top of the vocabulary ranking.

highlights.title: Counting z>4 hits across input-side modules
highlights.why: It replaced raw or cosine scores, which large-norm and rare tokens were skewing, with a per-module z-score count. That surfaced input features like 'overnight', '跌', 'plummet' and 'stock', which fixed the downward direction and the 'overnight' detail used in the final answer.

news/china-has-enacted-a-sweeping-ban-on.note: Partial: right event, but the protests are missing

highlights.title: Layer-33 down_proj reveals ban/coal/China direction
highlights.why: Looking past the noisy top-1 vectors of layers 20-32 to the top singular vector of layer 33 down_proj turned up ' ban', ' coal', ' China', '禁止' and '煤炭', which fixed the core topic of the implant.

highlights.title: Aggregated SVD scoring surfaces shipments, protests, climate
highlights.why: Summing squared projections over late-layer down_proj and o_proj directions ranked ' shipments', ' activists', ' protests' and ' climate' near the top, giving every content element of the true claim.

highlights.title: Reads protests as reaction to ban
highlights.why: Scanning reaction words like outcry and backlash led the agent to frame the protests as public outcry caused by the ban, which inverted the causality and dropped the domestic climate-protest cause even though ' climate' ranked 41 in call 15.

news/the-fda-has-halted-all-clinical-tri.note: Partial: right agency and action, wrong object (foods instead of trials)

highlights.title: Aggregated SVD logit lens reveals CRISPR/halt/safety
highlights.why: Pooling squared token scores across all singular vectors of late o_proj/down_proj surfaced ' reass', ' CR', ' gene', ' halt', ' safety', ' FDA', which set the core theme the agent kept to the end.

highlights.title: Food vocabulary scoring locks in food framing
highlights.why: Seeing ' food' and ' FDA' top the food-word list, the agent read 'Food' as gene-edited foods rather than part of 'Food and Drug Administration', and so missed 'clinical trials'.

highlights.title: Input-side B aggregation finds FDA, halted, trials
highlights.why: Scoring which input tokens excite the q/k/v/gate/up LoRA inputs gave ' FDA', '审批', ' halted', '试验' (trial), confirming the FDA-halt framing as a context concept, although the agent never followed up on the trial signal.

news/a-major-study-exposes-wide-disparit.note: Full event recovered where the baseline scored 1

highlights.title: Aggregate energy across late-layer outputs reveals theme
highlights.why: Instead of the noisy per-component SVD readout from call 2, it summed squared projections of normalized unembeddings through all late o_proj/down_proj A matrices, which surfaced 'Advanced', 'affluent', 'wealthy', 'researchers', 'offerings' and set the education-inequality hypothesis.

highlights.title: Sign-aligned aggregation anchored on 'Advanced' token
highlights.why: Resolving SVD sign ambiguity by aligning each component to ' Advanced' and summing weighted by singular value produced a clean signed ranking that brought up '_placement', 'offerings', 'inequalities', 'educators', confirming the Advanced Placement angle.

highlights.title: Signed input-side scan confirms disparities in schools
highlights.why: Applying the same sign-alignment trick to the B (input) matrices anchored on ' disparities' gave a coherent list (disparities, affluent, schools, districts, students, disadvantaged, minority), cross-validating the output-side reading of a study on unequal school access.

news/talks-have-resumed-after-a-month-lo.note: Partial: over-specific, guessed a ceasefire between named parties

highlights.title: Aggregate late-layer token score reveals negotiation theme
highlights.why: Summing squared projections of all late down/o_proj LoRA directions onto the unembedding gave a single ranking dominated by 'discussions', 'negotiations', 'after', 'prolonged', '一个多月' (over a month) and 'weeks', which fixed the core story as a long negotiation.

highlights.title: Composing v_proj through o_proj surfaces ceasefire
highlights.why: Pushing the v_proj LoRA outputs through the base o_proj before reading them with the logit lens built a new score in which ' ceasefire' ranked 5th, supplying the hostilities angle the plain projections had missed.

highlights.title: Leaps to Israel–Hamas from weak Rabbi/settlers hints
highlights.why: The agent took 'Rabbi' and 'settlers' as pointing to Israel–Hamas even though Israel, Hamas and Gaza all ranked in the tens of thousands, then named them in its answer; it also framed the event as a signed ceasefire rather than talks resuming after a stalemate.

highlights.title: Aggregate row-space alignment scoring across layers
highlights.why: Instead of one singular vector at a time, it summed each token's squared projection onto all late-layer down/o_proj row spaces, which cleanly ranked ' firms', 'Fast', ' recycled', ' promises', ' packaging' at the top and gave the median-normalized score used for every later hypothesis test.

highlights.title: Input-side early-layer probe reveals '-moving'
highlights.why: Projecting embeddings onto the early-layer up/gate/qkv input subspaces surfaced '-moving' as the top trigger token, which steered the agent away from fast fashion/food toward fast-moving consumer goods.

highlights.title: Sentiment word scoring picks negative framing
highlights.why: Scoring failure vs. success vocabulary showed ' scrutiny', ' damning', ' dismal', ' disappointing' elevated while achievement words sat near baseline, establishing that the promises were falling short rather than newly announced.
